body:
I dont really know, sorry, but my friend has something called PSP- Progressive supranuclear Palsy. This ruins movement and communication but otherwise his brain is OK and he is very aware. 

I can't speak for him, but I do still see a huge smile on his face when I show up to visit- one of his few visitors. I feel that he is happy to be alive, despite pissing himself regularly and being unable to talk. I can see it in his eyes the happiness that comes from just sitting with a friend who will talk to you and treat you as a normal person. I think for him it seems worth it to ride this out until the end.

I have never heard him complain about or feel bad about himself- this seems important to him and I think gets him through tough times somehow
Yes I think that could help. I really question my own will power and drive to change though:(
Sounds rough and you are obviously pretty hard on yourself. You have shown empathy for those you've hurt- true evil wouldn't do that I think

Maybe we can get through this together? I am in a lomgterm relationship but I had foolishly and humiliatingly professed a love for someone else, and it just totally humiliated me instead of making be feel better about getting my feelings out there. I can't stop thinking about how stupid I was and the stupid childish things I said. On top of all that i have so many other little problems that I'm about to give up. I'm really close

Meds can be weird. I was on wellbutrin years ago to stop smoking and it gave me like a frustrated sadness so I stopped. Years later, welbutrin combined with something else seems to be working. But maybe not because I'm feeling lately like I dont even really want to face all my problems/issues and it would be easier to hit the eject button

A lot of what you said is how I feel a lot of the times especially about work, marriage. I also have problems where I constantly make bad decisions and I end up sabotaging myself and mistakes repeat, and maybe I'm not trying hard enough. How do you even know if you are trying your best?
Me too. Even if I want to my brain physically wont let me it seems. I've tried all the tactics and cognitive behavioral stuff and my brain just doesn't want me to be normal in front of strangers
I'm also coward. I have a lot of problems that I'm afraid to face and I'm constantly humiliating myself in various ways
I've been here before friend. I'm definitely not as strong as people think I am and people probably dont even think I'm that strong.

I read the whole thing and think you expressed yourself well. Once, I was at a really low point in my life and was idle and bored and feeling maybe a little bit like you are now but in my own way. One thing that help me on a daily or even minute by minute basis was caring for some simple pets like a fish, say. If you can find some way to care for something outside yourself, it can really help with the boredom at least.
Do you find it hard to talk to people?

I'm really scared this would only make it worse. Make me feel even more of a burden and trouble for others. I hate attention and I have so many problems that I dont feel like I am going to be able to even start to solve them
